title: Seletar Airport (WSSL), Singapore, for private jets
description: Seletar Airport, Singapore: runway, customs and immigration, night curfew, aircraft size limits and how private flights clear, from the official Singapore AIP.
lead: Seletar Airport in the north of Singapore has its own Business Aviation Centre. What a private flight here involves, checked against the official Singapore Aeronautical Information Publication.

sections.h: What it is like to fly from Seletar
p: Seletar is run by {{wssl.operator}} and sits {{wssl.location}}. Private passengers do not go through an airline terminal: {{wssl.bac}}. Customs and immigration are {{wssl.ciq}}.
Every flight is handled locally: {{wssl.handler}}. The operator of your flight appoints the handler; we make sure the handler has your passenger details, catering and transport in good time.

The airport has a night curfew: {{wssl.curfew}}. A late-evening arrival or an early departure therefore needs planning. If your timing falls inside the curfew, we adjust the schedule with you before anything is booked; Changi is an alternative only for larger aircraft.
Fuel is available {{wssl.fuel}}. The operator plans the fuel for your schedule around these hours.

Seletar has {{wssl.runway}}. Parking is limited by stand size: {{wssl.maxstand}}. Whether a particular aircraft can use the runway at the weight your trip needs is the operator's calculation; we have it confirmed before you receive a quote.
There is also a noise rule: {{wssl.noise}}. Every operator we propose is checked against it before you receive a quote.

For most business jets there is no choice: Changi is {{wsss.notable}}. Seletar is the airport for private jets in Singapore. Changi becomes an option for larger aircraft, such as converted airliners used for groups, and then with its own timing rule: {{wsss.nsarrival}}. We check both airports for every Singapore trip and tell you which one works for your aircraft and times.

Everything on this page comes from the Singapore Aeronautical Information Publication; {{wssl.amdt}}. Airport rules can change at short notice. The operator and its handler confirm the current rules for your flight before departure.

faq.q: Can a private jet land at Seletar at night?
faq.a: No, except medical evacuation and emergency flights: {{wssl.curfew}}.

faq.q: Where do private passengers clear immigration at Seletar?
faq.a: At the airport itself: {{wssl.bac}}. Customs and immigration are {{wssl.ciq}}.

faq.q: Which is better for a private flight, Seletar or Changi?
faq.a: For a business jet, Seletar: Changi is {{wsss.notable}}. Changi is an option for larger aircraft with more seats, outside its evening arrival window. We check both for every trip.
